svg.title: From source text to an exact report

cc:Work.dc:title: From source text to an exact report
cc:Work.dc:description: Complete offline-report application benchmark. Five methods on three independent real sources; four unique-query counts and nine fresh-process trials per method, 540 processes. Times include query-plan reading, source parsing, construction, operations, output and process exit. Memory is measured process peak RSS, not representation size. Medians and observed min–max; no confidence interval. OS file cache not flushed; preparation excluded. Source JSON SHA-256: 5223bce81a5fc0036820e6ddb0e49b1fb4f64a0fdb80b29295eb966aadaf40e4
